_comment: Last upstream versions reviewed and accounted for. Updated by the weekly kia_uvo review task.

open_alerts.summary: Library 5.3.0+ drops Python 3.12 (needs 3.13+). We are held at 5.2.1; following kia_uvo 4.1.0 (5.3.1) means raising the MagicMirror bridge's minimum Python and auto-provisioned CPython to 3.13.
Tyre pressure sensors keep the last known reading while parked and restore it after an HA restart (kia_uvo #1930). Changes existing sensor behaviour; not built.
